Case ID: 1189
Case Type: HR Request
Date: 2025-04-08
Handled By: HR - Jonah Price
Customer or Requestor: Internal Manager - Rebecca Shaw
Title: Manager request for attendance policy clarification

Issue Description
A support manager requested clarification on how to apply the attendance policy to repeated late arrivals linked to a temporary public transit disruption.

Steps Taken
- Reviewed the applicable attendance policy and any location-specific flexibility guidance already issued.
- Gathered the employee's attendance record, prior coaching history, and evidence of the transit disruption timeframe.
- Discussed practical scheduling options with the manager, including temporary shift adjustments and documentation expectations.
- Documented the advisory guidance in the HR case record for consistency if similar situations arose.

Resolution
Advised the manager to use temporary schedule flexibility and documented coaching rather than immediate corrective action because the issue was time-bound, verified, and not a pattern of misconduct.

Follow-Up
HR shared a reminder with people managers on handling location-wide commuting disruptions consistently.
